AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-27-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Carl Salceda.
Petitioner: Lingilu Lakalaka, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Donny Illi Jr. Salfai, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to: Owen Jr. Lakalaka.
Decree signed in open court.

MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Carlito Mandia.
Petitioner: Lingilu Lakalaka present in pro per with the minor: Donny Illi Jr. Salafai, was sworn and examined.
Without consent and proper notification the the minor's father, the petitioner request for change of minor's name is DENIED.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-09-2004 Reset To Apr-27-04 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Deborah Neville.
Petitioner Lingilu Lakalaka present in pro per for the minor: Donny Illi Salafai, Jr., was sworn and examined.
Application requesting order Dispensing Notice and Declaration Re: Due Diligence filed in Court. The Court Order: denying the request in open court.
This matter in continued to Apr. 27, 2004 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218, for Petitioner to serve notice on Minor's father and file proof of service with the Court.
